description.value:
Duration constant

Everything you have ever been good at came from being willing to wait exactly one beat longer than the other person.

Your Draw’s distance damage no longer caps out. Every range increment beyond the second continues to add its die with no upper limit, out to the limit of your weapon and your eyesight. In addition, a Hot Load fired at a target more than three range increments away does not widen your Failure Range — at that distance you had the time to load it properly.

cinderfall.incomplete: both clauses are homebrew-subsystem (distance-damage ladder, Hot Load) dependent. This effect is defined entirely in terms of a Cinderfall-homebrew subsystem with zero Foundry schema footprint (the Gun Failure Table/Failure Range, hazardous ground, time-in-sights, Trick Iron charge bank, or Drift/augment-slot cost). Confirmed via the full rule-element type listing (pf2e-source/src/module/rules/rule-element/, 40 files): no RollTable-manipulation, no persistent-terrain-hazard, and no arbitrary stacking-counter rule element type exists to hook any of these to. This card depends on (upgrades, extends, or is gated behind) another Ironsight card in this same package that itself ships rules: [] -- if the parent has nothing real to build on, the child has nothing real to extend either.
